videos.title: Is soil actually alive? | with Frank Ashwood
videos.author: The Royal Institution
videos.description:
Soil is home to an estimated 59% of Earth’s species, and most of us never give it a thought. Soil ecologist and photographer Frank Ashwood takes us layer by layer through the living world beneath our feet.

From leaf litter to deep subsoil, meet the creatures that keep our planet running: springtail

videos.title: From the PhD Lab: How do biofilms help keep bacteria alive? - with Josh Horton
videos.author: The Royal Institution
videos.description:
Microorganisms are constantly adapting to evade human-made interventions such as antibiotics and sanitisers. One of these adaptations is to use their strength in numbers and form a biofilm. 

One bacteria in particular forms biofilms that we encounter in many situations in our everyday life - salmon
